meals.recipe_name: Spanish-Style Scrambled Eggs with Chorizo and Potato
recipe_steps: Peel the russet potato and dice into 1/4-inch cubes. Pat dry with a paper towel.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat (about 325°F). Add the diced potato and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring every 2 minutes, for 10 minutes until golden and fork-tender.
Dice the chorizo into 1/4-inch pieces and finely dice the 1/4 onion. Add both to the skillet and cook 4 minutes until the chorizo releases its oil and the onion softens.
Crack 4 eggs into a bowl, add 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper, and whisk 30 seconds until uniform.

Reduce heat to medium-low (about 275°F). Pour eggs over the potato-chorizo mixture. Let set 20 seconds, then fold gently with a spatula every 15 seconds for about 2 minutes until softly scrambled and just set.
Toast the 2 slices of whole wheat bread and serve alongside the scramble immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Peel and dice 1 medium russet potato into 1/4-inch cubes and finely dice 1/4 onion. Store together in an airtight container with potato submerged in cold water to prevent browning; refrigerate up to 1 day.

meals.recipe_name: Grilled Chicken Burrito Bowl
recipe_steps: Pat the 8 oz chicken breast dry and rub with 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp olive oil.
Heat a grill pan over medium-high (about 400°F). Grill chicken 6 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice into strips.
Warm 1 cup cooked white rice and 1/2 cup black beans in the microwave for 90 seconds. Stir juice of half a lime and chopped cilantro into the rice.
Dice the Roma tomato. Warm 1/2 cup corn in the pan 2 minutes until charred.
Assemble bowl: rice base, then beans, corn, tomato, sliced chicken. Top with 1/4 cup shredded cheddar and remaining lime juice squeezed over.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday lunch, or cold-water thaw sealed Monday morning (~40 min, change water every 30 min).
Cook 2 cups dry white rice in 3 cups water (covered, simmer 18 min); cool and refrigerate for use across early-week meals (up to 4 days).

meals.recipe_name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Garlic Butter Asparagus and Quinoa
recipe_steps: Pat salmon dry and season both sides with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (about 400°F). Place salmon skin-side down and sear 4 minutes without moving.
Flip and sear 3 more minutes until internal temp reaches 125°F for medium. Remove to a plate.
Lower heat to medium. Add 1 tbsp butter and 2 minced garlic cloves. Add asparagus spears and saute 4 minutes until crisp-tender, tossing in garlic butter.
Warm 3/4 cup cooked quinoa. Plate quinoa, salmon, and asparagus; squeeze juice of 1/2 lemon over everything and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday dinner, or cold-water thaw sealed Monday afternoon (~30 min).
Rinse 1 cup dry quinoa, simmer in 2 cups water covered 15 min; cool and refrigerate up to 4 days for early-week meals.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Berry Protein Bowl
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup mixed berries and 1/4 cup granola.
Drizzle 1 tbsp honey and sprinkle 1 tbsp chopped almonds. Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Toast with Tomato and Chili Flakes
recipe_steps: Toast 2 slices whole wheat bread until golden.
Spread 1 cup cottage cheese across both slices.
Top with sliced Roma tomato, drizzle 1 tsp olive oil, sprinkle 1/4 tsp chili flakes and 1/4 tsp salt. Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Overnight Protein Oats with Banana and Peanut Butter
recipe_steps: Retrieve the prepped jar of overnight oats from the fridge.
Stir oats thoroughly; add a splash more almond milk if too thick.
Slice 1 banana over the top and swirl in 2 tbsp peanut butter. Serve cold or microwave 60 seconds if preferred warm.

prep_tasks.instructions: Combine 2/3 cup rolled oats, 1 cup unsweetened almond milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, and 1 tsp chia seeds in a jar. Stir well, cover, refrigerate overnight (eaten next morning).

meals.recipe_name: Thai Beef Basil Stir-Fry (Pad Krapow) over Rice
recipe_steps: Mince 3 garlic cloves and 1 Thai chili. Mix 1.5 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp fish sauce, and 1 tsp sugar in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat (about 450°F). Add garlic and chili, stir 15 seconds until fragrant.
Add 7 oz ground beef, breaking it up. Stir-fry 4 minutes until browned and moisture evaporates.
Pour in the sauce mixture and stir-fry 1 minute to coat. Turn off heat and toss in 1/2 cup Thai basil until wilted.
Fry 1 egg in a separate pan in a little oil over medium-high until edges are crispy and yolk still runny, about 2 minutes.
Serve beef over 1 cup warm rice, topped with the fried egg.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz ground beef from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday lunch, or cold-water thaw sealed Tuesday morning (~35 min).

meals.recipe_name: Garlic Shrimp and Spinach Linguine
recipe_steps: Boil 4 oz linguine in salted water per package directions (about 9 minutes). Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
While pasta cooks, pat 8 oz shrimp dry and season with 1/4 tsp salt.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high (about 400°F). Sear shrimp 90 seconds per side until pink; remove.
Lower heat to medium, add remaining 1 tbsp butter and 4 minced garlic cloves; cook 45 seconds. Add 2 cups spinach and wilt 1 minute.
Add drained linguine, a splash of pasta water, 1/4 tsp chili flakes, and juice of 1/2 lemon. Toss. Return shrimp, add 2 tbsp parmesan, toss and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner, or cold-water thaw sealed Tuesday afternoon (~20 min).

meals.recipe_name: Tuna Cucumber Boats
recipe_steps: Drain tuna and mix with 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, juice of 1/4 lemon, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/8 tsp pepper.
Halve the cucumber lengthwise and scoop out seeds to form boats.
Fill cucumber halves with tuna mixture and serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Dark Chocolate Protein Shake
recipe_steps: Add 1 cup whole milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 1 banana, 1 tbsp peanut butter, and 4 ice cubes to a blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth. Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey Sausage and Cheddar Breakfast Quesadilla
recipe_steps: Shape and cook the homemade tortillas from the prepped dough: divide rested dough into 2 balls, roll each into an 8-inch round on a floured surface.
Heat a dry skillet over medium-high (about 400°F). Cook each tortilla 60 seconds per side until puffed with brown spots. Set aside.
Season 4 oz ground turkey with 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp paprika, and 1/4 tsp crushed fennel seed. Cook in a skillet over medium-high 5 minutes, crumbling, until browned.
Whisk 3 eggs with 1/4 tsp salt. Push turkey aside, add eggs to the same pan, and scramble 2 minutes until just set.
Lay one tortilla in the pan over medium heat, sprinkle 1/3 cup cheddar, add turkey-egg mix, top with second tortilla. Cook 2 minutes per side until crisp and cheese melts. Slice into wedges.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 4 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday breakfast, or cold-water thaw sealed Wednesday morning (~30 min).

Mix 1.25 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, and 1/2 cup warm water into a dough. Knead 5 min until smooth, cover, rest in fridge overnight. Bring to room temp before rolling.

meals.recipe_name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl with Broccoli
recipe_steps: Whisk 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 minced garlic clove, 1 tsp grated ginger, and 1 tsp cornstarch dissolved in 2 tbsp water.
Cut 8 oz chicken thigh into bite-size pieces. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high (400°F) and cook chicken 6 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F and edges brown.
Add the sauce and simmer 2 minutes until it thickens and glazes the chicken.
Steam 1.5 cups broccoli in a covered pot with 2 tbsp water for 4 minutes until bright green and tender.
Serve chicken over 1 cup rice with broccoli; sprinkle 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken thigh from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch, or cold-water thaw sealed Wednesday morning (~40 min).

meals.recipe_name: Bison Burger with Sweet Potato Wedges
recipe_steps: Bake the proofed homemade bun: shape dough into a ball, let it come to room temp and puff 30 min, bake at 375°F for 18 minutes until golden; cool and slice.
Cut sweet potato into wedges, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper. Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Form 8 oz bison into a patty, season both sides with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high (425°F) with 1 tbsp oil. Sear patty 3 minutes per side for medium; add cheddar in last minute to melt.
Assemble burger on the bun with lettuce, tomato, and patty. Serve with sweet potato wedges.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday dinner, or cold-water thaw sealed Wednesday afternoon (~35 min).
Mix 1.5 cups flour, 3/4 tsp instant yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup warm water, 1 tbsp olive oil. Knead 8 min, cover, cold-ferment in fridge overnight. Shape and proof day-of before baking.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple and Walnuts
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup pineapple chunks and 2 tbsp chopped walnuts.
Drizzle 1 tsp honey and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Vanilla Protein Shake with Oats
recipe_steps: Blend 1 cup milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein, 1/4 cup oats, 1 banana, and ice on high 45 seconds.
Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Bagel Scramble
recipe_steps: Whisk 4 eggs with 1/4 tsp pepper.
Melt 1 tsp butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low (275°F). Add eggs and gently fold for 2 minutes until softly set.
Fold in 3 oz torn smoked salmon and 2 tbsp cream cheese in small dollops; remove from heat as cheese melts into creamy pockets.
Toast 2 slices bread. Plate scramble, sprinkle 1 tbsp chopped chives, serve with toast.

meals.recipe_name: Korean Pork Bulgogi Rice Bowl
recipe_steps: Retrieve marinated pork from fridge.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a skillet over high (450°F). Add pork in a single layer and sear 3 minutes per side until caramelized and cooked to 160°F.
Add 1 tbsp gochujang and toss 1 minute to glaze.
Serve pork over 1 cup warm rice; top with sliced green onion and 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz pork from freezer to fridge Wednesday morning. Wednesday evening, marinate in 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger; refrigerate 12-18 hours for Thursday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken Thighs with Couscous
recipe_steps: Pat chicken thighs dry. Rub with 1 tbsp olive oil, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, zest of 1 lemon, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper.
Roast skin-side up on a sheet pan at 425°F for 30 minutes until skin is crisp and internal temp hits 175°F.
At the 15-minute mark, toss sliced zucchini with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper and add to the pan.
Bring 1 cup water to a boil, stir in 3/4 cup couscous, cover and remove from heat 5 minutes; fluff with a fork and juice of half the lemon.
Plate couscous, chicken, and zucchini; squeeze remaining lemon over.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 10 oz bone-in chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner, or cold-water thaw sealed Thursday afternoon (~45 min).

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Peanut Butter Dip with Apple
recipe_steps: Stir 3/4 cup Greek yogurt with 1 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tsp honey, and 1/4 tsp cinnamon.
Slice apple and serve alongside for dipping.

meals.recipe_name: Hard-Boiled Eggs and Almonds
recipe_steps: Place 3 eggs in a pot, cover with cold water, bring to a boil, then cover and remove from heat 11 minutes.
Transfer to ice water 5 minutes, peel, sprinkle with 1/4 tsp salt.
Serve with 1/4 cup almonds.

meals.recipe_name: Protein Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Berries
recipe_steps: Blend 1/2 cup oats, 2 eggs, 1 scoop vanilla protein, 1 banana, and 1 tsp baking powder into a smooth batter.
Melt 1 tsp butter in a nonstick pan over medium (350°F). Pour 1/4-cup portions and cook 2 minutes until bubbles form, flip, cook 1 minute more. Repeat for 3-4 pancakes.
Stack pancakes, top with 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup berries, and 1 tbsp maple syrup.

meals.recipe_name: Blackened Tuna Steak Tacos
recipe_steps: Shape 3 tortillas from the prepped dough, roll to 6 inches, cook in a dry skillet over medium-high 45 seconds per side; keep warm.
Mix 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp cayenne, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp salt. Coat tuna steak on both sides.
Heat a cast-iron skillet very hot (475°F) with 1 tbsp oil. Sear tuna 90 seconds per side for rare center; slice thin.
Mix 2 tbsp Greek yogurt with juice of 1/2 lime and 1/4 tsp salt for crema.
Fill tortillas with shredded cabbage, sliced tuna, crema, and a squeeze of lime.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz tuna steak from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday lunch, or cold-water thaw sealed Friday morning (~30 min).
Mix 1.25 cups flour, 1/4 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1/2 cup warm water into a dough. Knead 5 min, cover, rest in fridge overnight. Room temp before rolling.

meals.recipe_name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry over Rice
recipe_steps: Slice flank steak thin against the grain. Toss with 1 tsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Mix remaining 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp cornstarch, 1 tsp sesame oil, and 1/4 cup water for the sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high (475°F). Sear beef 2 minutes until browned; remove.
Add broccoli and 2 tbsp water, cover 2 minutes. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger, stir 30 seconds.
Return beef, pour in sauce, stir 1 minute until glossy and thick. Serve over 1 cup rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday dinner, or cold-water thaw sealed Friday afternoon (~40 min).
Cook 2 cups dry white rice in 3 cups water (covered, simmer 18 min); cool and refrigerate for Friday-weekend meals (up to 4 days).

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Protein Bowl with Granola
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/4 cup granola, 1/2 cup berries, and drizzle 1 tsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Shake
recipe_steps: Blend 1 cup milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana, and ice on high 45 seconds.
Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Shakshuka with Feta and Crusty Bread
recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium (350°F). Saute diced 1/2 onion and diced bell pepper 5 minutes until soft.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika; stir 30 seconds.
Pour in 1 cup crushed tomatoes and 1/2 tsp salt; simmer 6 minutes until thickened.
Make 4 wells and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook 6 minutes until whites set and yolks are runny.
Crumble 1/4 cup feta over top. Serve with toasted bread for dipping.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey and Avocado Club Sandwich
recipe_steps: Bake the prepped sandwich bread: shape proofed dough into a loaf, bake at 375°F for 28 minutes until golden and hollow-sounding; cool and slice.
Season 6 oz ground turkey with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp paprika; form into a thin patty.
Cook patty in a skillet with 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high (400°F) 4 minutes per side to 165°F; top with cheddar last minute.
Toast 2 bread slices. Layer turkey patty, mashed avocado, lettuce, and tomato into a sandwich. Slice and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday lunch, or cold-water thaw sealed Saturday morning (~30 min).
Mix 2 cups flour, 1 tsp instant yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 3/4 cup warm water, 1 tbsp olive oil. Knead 8 min, cold-ferment in fridge 1-2 days. Shape and proof 1 hr day-of before baking Saturday.

meals.recipe_name: Garlic Butter Steak with Mashed Potatoes and Green Beans
recipe_steps: Peel and cube 2 potatoes; boil in salted water 15 minutes until fork-tender. Drain and mash with 1 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup milk, 1/2 tsp salt.
Pat ribeye dry, season generously with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper. Let sit 10 minutes at room temp.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over high (475°F). Sear steak 3 minutes per side.
Reduce heat to medium, add 2 tbsp butter, 3 smashed garlic cloves, and thyme. Baste steak with foaming butter 90 seconds. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Steam green beans 4 minutes until crisp-tender; toss in the garlic butter from the pan. Plate steak, mash, and beans.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 10 oz ribeye from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner, or cold-water thaw sealed Saturday afternoon (~45 min).

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Mango Smoothie Bowl
recipe_steps: Blend 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup frozen mango, and 1/2 banana until thick.
Pour into a bowl, top with 2 tbsp granola and 1 tsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Vanilla Protein Shake with Almonds
recipe_steps: Blend 1 cup milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein, and ice 40 seconds.
Serve with 2 tbsp almonds on the side.

meals.recipe_name: Steak and Egg Breakfast Hash
recipe_steps: Dice 1 potato, 1/2 bell pepper, and 1/4 onion. Heat 1.5 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high (400°F). Add potato, cook 10 minutes stirring occasionally.
Add pepper and onion; cook 4 minutes until softened. Season with 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper.
Cut sirloin into cubes, season with 1/4 tsp salt. Push hash aside, sear steak 3 minutes to medium.
Make 3 wells and crack in eggs; cover 3 minutes until whites set. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz sirloin from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday breakfast, or cold-water thaw sealed Sunday morning (~25 min).

meals.recipe_name: Shrimp Fried Rice
recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high (475°F). Sear 7 oz shrimp 90 seconds per side; remove.
Scramble 2 eggs in the wok 1 minute; push aside. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 3/4 cup peas and carrots, stir 2 minutes.
Add 1.5 cups cold cooked rice, breaking clumps. Stir-fry 3 minutes until rice crisps slightly.
Return shrimp, add 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp sesame oil; toss 1 minute. Finish with sliced green onion.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch, or cold-water thaw sealed Sunday morning (~20 min).
Use day-old cold cooked rice from Friday's batch (best for fried rice texture); keep refrigerated until Sunday.

meals.recipe_name: Baked Cod with Chorizo White Beans
recipe_steps: Dice 2 oz chorizo. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium (350°F), cook chorizo 3 minutes to render.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, stir 30 seconds. Add 1 cup cannellini beans and 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes; simmer 4 minutes.
Stir in 1.5 cups spinach until wilted. Season with 1/2 tsp salt.
Pat cod dry, season with salt, nestle on top of the beans. Bake at 400°F for 12 minutes until cod flakes at 140°F.
Squeeze 1/2 lemon over and serve from the skillet.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 9 oz cod fillet from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner, or cold-water thaw sealed Sunday afternoon (~30 min).

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese with Honey and Peaches
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with sliced peach, 1 tbsp chopped walnuts, and 1 tsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Banana Protein Shake
recipe_steps: Blend 1 cup milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 1 banana, 1/4 cup oats, and ice on high 45 seconds.
Serve immediately.
